crystal_phase.Ni–Fe alloy: face-centered cubic nickel phase (JCPDS Card No. 89-7128)

Proof in the paper: The XRD patterns (Figure 1j and Figure S3 in the Supporting Information) of these Ni1–xFex/NC samples were similar to each other, with three distinct diffraction peaks located around 44.3, 51.7, and 76.2°, which can be assigned to the (111), (200), and (220) crystal-plane reflections of a face-centered cubic nickel phase (JCPDS Card No. 89-7128).
